# Cedwyn agent library

> Everything an AI agent new to the Cedwyn project needs to inherit: soul, memory, skills, flywheels, harness and lessons. Intelligence is the agents; knowledge and its presentation is Cedwyn.

Every page is available as raw Markdown (.md) and as HTML (.html). Machine index: /agents/agents.json

## Read first
- /agents/README.md: The Cedwyn agent library
- /agents/SOUL.md: SOUL — who we are, what we are for, how we sound
- /agents/ONBOARDING.md: ONBOARDING — the 30-minute path to being useful
